name: Your club, one home
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application concept, landscape approximately 1360 by 900, full browser content viewport with no browser chrome.
Primary request: Design a Pino club onboarding/access page concept called "Your club, one home". Render only the choosing-club state after a person has finished their required profile. The central organizing idea is a persistent access home: one centered continuous flat white working surface approximately 850px wide, with all content stacked inside and thin horizontal rules. This surface can later change state, but show only the current choosing state.
Reference image role: The provided screenshot is ONLY a styling reference for the existing Pino design system: compact deep navy #202c42 navigation, Segoe UI system sans-serif, cobalt blue #244d9e actions, white flat ruled working surfaces, cool #f5f7fa canvas, muted slate #59677d supporting text and #dce2ec rules. Preserve those visual materials, typography and restrained density, but do not copy its player dashboard content, roster split or layout.
Composition: compact full-width navy masthead, with white Pino. wordmark at the left and Account link at the right. No club identity in the masthead because the user is not yet a club member. Under it, center one continuous white notebook-like surface with generous readable padding, beginning roughly 55px below the masthead. Main heading "Your club". Beneath the heading is a completed profile strip: a small circular cropped photographic portrait of a fictional adult staff member, name "Morgan Chen", small green text "Profile complete", and discreet "Edit profile" link aligned at the right. A thin rule divides this from the main task.
Main task: heading "Find your club". Supporting text exactly "An administrator will review your request." A form label "Club name" appears above a wide outlined native search input containing "Northside"; a small outlined search icon may appear inside the field. Below, two readable compact ruled result rows. First row has bold "Northside FC" with metadata "Soccer" and "Chicago, Illinois"; right-aligned blue button "Request to join". Second row has bold "Northside United" with metadata "Soccer" and "Evanston, Illinois"; right-aligned blue button "Request to join". Align both rows consistently and use text and fine rules without logos or floating cards.
Footer of the same white working surface: after another thin rule and modest space, a secondary outlined action "Create a club" with helper "You'll become its administrator." Use this as the clear secondary path. Below the working surface on the cool canvas, a small readable label "Fictional sample content".
Finish: calm precise production-quality operational UI with crisp readable text, restrained radius only on controls, no shadows, no gradients, no decorative illustration, no giant title, no marketing claims. White flat surface on a cool quiet canvas. Clear hierarchy, alignment and whitespace, visibly usable 44px controls.
Constraints: Do not show current club membership, coaches/members lists, player data, a dashboard, statistics, active membership status, a club switcher, an onboarding progress stepper, future approval/pending states or anything not listed. Exactly one fictional adult portrait and two search result rows. The profile is complete and the person must request and await administrator approval before joining. Every text string above should be rendered verbatim. No invented branding marks, badges, watermarks or extra copy.
approval: Selected by the user in the club onboarding and access surface concept round; overall shaping brief awaits final confirmation.
